stem: An extension cord has a visibly crushed section after being routed under a rolling bench. What should the technician do?
choices: Move the bench and continue using the cord if power remains on
Tape the flattened area and restrict the cord to low-power tools
Remove the damaged cord from use and reroute the replacement away from pinch paths
Place a floor mat over the cord so the damage is no longer exposed
rationale: Portable cords should be visually inspected and damaged equipment removed rather than cosmetically covered or reused.
